_about: Every hex type the map can hold (SPEC.md › What each tile does). The 13 tile types players land on, plus start/throne/plain/courier and the three void flavours. `glyph` is the emoji placeholder until the tile art lands; `acts` is who acts on the phone; `resolves` says whether landing on it triggers a tile hook (void hexes are never entered). The encounters/tiles module registers the hook per type through hooks.js › tileHooks.

encounter.name: Encounter
encounter.acts: Mover; allies on the tile may join
encounter.text: A monster from the region's table appears with its own Health and two moves. Fight it with your items; it drops Gold, an item or an egg when it dies.

wheel.name: Wheel
wheel.text: Spin the Fortune Wheel for Health, Gold or an item.

shop.name: Shop
shop.text: Buy items, potions and trinkets with Gold; sell back at half price.

inn.name: Inn
inn.text: Safe tile: heal once per visit, buy potions, the Collector skips you this round.

bloodbank.name: Blood Bank
bloodbank.text: Take or repay a Blood Pact.

graveyard.name: Graveyard
graveyard.text: Dead players wake here after their missed turns; what they dropped stays where they fell.

arena.name: Arena
arena.text: Challenge a player to a Challenge Wheel fight or a pet battle with a Gold wager and a crowd bonus.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.acts: Mover; a vote if the result asks for a victim
chaos.text: Spin the Chaos Wheel; tiers escalate as the run goes on.

chest.name: Chest
chest.text: Spin the Loot Wheel for an item (rarity by region), Gold or an egg.

bossgate.name: Boss Gate
bossgate.acts: Mover; allies on the tile for raids
bossgate.text: Fight the region boss if level or key allows, else bounce back three tiles.

portal.name: Portal
portal.text: Pick a destination region and step through.

bounty.name: Bounty Board
bounty.text: Place or claim a bounty; take a public quest.

start.name: The Sign
start.text: Where the run begins, under the one sign still lit. A safe tile.

throne.name: The Throne
throne.text: The Dealer's chair. Sit on it once the Dealer is dead and the run is won.

plain.name: Open Ground
plain.text: Nothing here but the rain. A place to stand.

courier.name: Courier Post
courier.text: The crow's roost. Letters in transit pass through here; whoever stands on it reads them first.

blocker.name: Dungheap
blocker.text: A destructible heap that blocks the hex and drops Gold when broken.

chasm.name: Chasm
chasm.text: A drop into smoke and cloud. Impassable.

wall.name: Wall
wall.text: Shuttered fronts and gallows trunks. Impassable.
